summary: Coeur d'Alene NF ground lookout on Grizzly Mountain, Shoshone County, ID: a 1914 stone-and-frame cabin, a 1929 cupola cabin, abandoned 1955; rock foundations remained at a 2022 visit.

facts.design: 12x12 stone and frame cabin (1914), replaced by a cupola cabin (1929)
facts.status_note: Abandoned 1955; rock foundations of the cabin and cupola were still on the site at a September 2022 visit

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as drive-up; no source says whether it is open to visitors today

visit.trail_note: The 2022 Idaho Fire Lookouts post describes the site but gives no route or trail

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says four crow's nest platforms still stand on the ridgetop; the September 2022 Idaho Fire Lookouts post says none remain. The Firelookout.com page is undated, so the order of the two is not known.
Firelookout.com gives Menno Miller; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives Manny Miller, citing the Kellogg Evening News of 07/01/1946. The story reports both spellings.

notes_for_editor: Brief kind is ground and status gone; sources agree on the 1914 cabin, 1929 cupola cabin and 1955 abandonment. Staff list runs 1930 to 1946 per Idaho Fire Lookouts. Conflicts: crow's nests (Firelookout.com says four remain; 2022 post says none) and the 1946 Miller first name. The 2022 visit is a single hobbyist account, not a survey. The web search gave a geocaching listing that was not fetched or used.
